faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Most projects run 8 to 36 weeks. A single-platform MVP can launch in 8 to 12 weeks, while enterprise builds with complex integrations take longer. Your app development timeline depends on feature scope, platform count, and how quickly feedback comes back during review cycles.

faqs.question: How much does mobile app development cost?
faqs.answer: Mobile app development cost typically ranges from $12,000 for an MVP to $150,000+ for enterprise platforms. Complexity, platform choice, and integration depth are the biggest drivers. We provide a fixed, itemized estimate after the discovery phase.

faqs.question: How do I get started if I only have an idea?
faqs.answer: That's a normal starting point. As a trusted mobile app development agency, our consulting phase converts a rough concept into a validated scope, wireframes, and a costed roadmap — before you commit to full development.

faqs.question: Should I build native or cross-platform?
faqs.answer: It depends on your performance needs and budget. A reliable mobile app development firm like us will guide you clearly: cross-platform using React Native or Flutter suits most products and reaches both stores faster, while heavy graphics or deep hardware access may justify going native. We'll advise either way honestly.

faqs.question: Can you take over an existing app built by another team?
faqs.answer: Yes. As one of the top mobile app development companies, we audit the existing codebase, document what we find, and either continue development or recommend app modernization services if the foundation won't support your goals.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our mobile app maintenance and support plans cover monitoring, bug fixes, OS compatibility updates, and feature enhancements, along with app store optimization services to improve visibility and download rates.

faqs.question: Who owns the code and intellectual property?
faqs.answer: You do, completely. All source code, designs, and documentation transfer to you, and access is provided throughout the project rather than at the end.

faqs.question: Can I hire a dedicated team instead of a fixed-scope project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many clients engage a dedicated mobile app development team on a monthly basis, giving them flexible capacity and direct control over priorities sprint by sprint.

AptenTech has spent years running mobile app development for startups chasing their first thousand users and for enterprises replacing systems older than their newest hires. The work is different.
